response:
Diagnosis: the archive now separates cleanly. (1) Ratio-of-level-to-volatility constructions failed (StableROIC t_alpha 0.69; QuietBalanceSheetProfit negative) — dividing by a volatility denominator creates a scale-distorted variable dominated by tiny denominators, so the stability idea should be tested as a *ranked channel*, not a divisor. (2) Balance-sheet-health composites work, with multiplicative conditioning delivering the alpha (HealthScored: 2.7%, t=2.0) and additive ranking delivering the cross-sectional slope and Sharpe (Additive: fmb 2.81, Sharpe 0.23) — suggesting the levels information is real but the multiplicative form concentrates it in the tails. (3) Debt-service capacity (EBITDA/debt, profit net of interest) is the single best new quality channel (alpha 1.9%, t 1.9). (4) Discrete persistence counts are dead (SelfFundedProfitStreak t_alpha 0.14). This batch repairs the volatility-as-denominator failure, consolidates the two strongest channels, and opens three new mechanisms: worst-case profit floor, profit-to-liabilities as a single interaction ratio, and debt maturity structure.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: TroughProfitFloor
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, at), 3), TS_MIN(RATIO(oiadp, ADD(dltt, ceq)), 5))
HYPOTHESIS: Durability is better measured by how high a firm's profitability floor is than by how smooth its profitability is; a high worst-year return on invested capital proves the business model survives its own cycle.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The first channel is the smoothed profitability level (profitability theme) and the second is the minimum five-year return on debt-plus-equity capital (quality theme via dltt), so firms are rewarded only when current strength rests on a high stress-case earnings base. This replaces the failed volatility-denominator idea with a downside-state concept that is robust to scale and does not blow up for small denominators. It also distinguishes levered profitability, since capital in the denominator includes long-term debt.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: ProfitToLiabilities
EXPRESSION: IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(oiadp, xint), lt), 1))
HYPOTHESIS: Operating profit after interest measured against the total stock of obligations is the cleanest single statement of the interaction: the same dollar of profit is worth more when fewer creditor claims stand against it.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The numerator is a profitability flow net of financing cost (oiadp, xint) and the denominator is total liabilities (lt, quality-exclusive), so leverage and profitability are fused into one economically interpretable coverage ratio rather than two ranked channels. Industry z-scoring removes structural differences in capital intensity and leverage norms, and the parsimony should deliver higher coverage and a more stable long-short membership than the three-channel composites. It is the natural minimal test of whether the archive's composite alphas come from the profitability-per-obligation channel itself.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: ConsolidatedDurableProfit
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, at), 3)), SUMRANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, ADD(dltt, dlc)), 2), RATIO(re, at)))
HYPOTHESIS: The two channels that independently generated alpha — debt-service capacity and retained-earnings depth — should reinforce each other, because a firm that can both cover its debt from current earnings and has historically retained profits has proven durable operating strength.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: It keeps the multiplicative conditioning structure that produced the archive's best FF5 alpha but replaces the weak net-working-capital channel with the stronger EBITDA-to-debt coverage channel from DebtServicedProfitSpread. This is a deliberate consolidation test: if alpha and t-alpha both rise relative to HealthScoredProfitability, the quality modulator is solvency rather than liquidity.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: RankedStabilityProfit
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(MA(RATIO(oiadp, ADD(dltt, ceq)), 3), NEG(VOL(RATIO(oiadp, ADD(dltt, ceq)), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: Profitability stability does predict returns, but only when it is combined as an independently ranked characteristic rather than used as a denominator that mechanically amplifies firms with near-zero variance.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This isolates one design choice against StableROIC: identical economic inputs (level and five-year volatility of return on invested capital) recombined additively through rank space. If the stability channel has real content, this version should show a materially better t-alpha, which would tell us that the gen-1 failure was construction rather than economics.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: DeleveragingProfitStrength
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(MA(RATIO(oiadp, at), 3), NEG(TREND(RATIO(lt, at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: Profitable firms that are steadily shrinking their liability base are converting operating strength into balance-sheet quality, while equally profitable firms on a multi-year leveraging path are borrowing their way to reported returns.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The second channel is the negative five-year trend in total-liabilities-to-assets (quality theme, lt), a slow-moving direction-of-travel variable rather than the noisy one-year debt growth that failed in gen 0. Pairing it additively with smoothed operating profitability tests whether capital-structure *improvement*, not its level or its volatility, is the durability marker.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: MaturityBackedProfit
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, at), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(dlc, ADD(dltt, dlc)))))
HYPOTHESIS: High profitability is more valuable when the debt financing it is long-dated; a heavy share of current debt exposes profitable firms to rollover and refinancing shocks that truncate the value of their earnings stream.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The quality modulator is debt maturity structure — the share of short-term debt in total debt (dlc, dltt) — a financial-health dimension untested in the archive and distinct from leverage level, coverage, or retained earnings. Multiplying industry ranks conditions the profitability premium on refinancing safety, so profitable firms funded with commercial paper are pushed toward the middle while equally profitable term-funded firms rise.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
